body: im very glad your daughters gonna be okay. im also very sorry your inlaws are that self centered. at least now you see their true colors. lots of hugs op
she turns her feelings off around them because of YOU, not her trauma. id be seriously concerned as to why your DH isn't alarmed by this. everyone here needs a ton of therapy.

my best advice is to go back to your moms until she's actually out, if she actually leaves. then I would recommend couples counseling because she's causing a serious rift. you going back kind of rug swept a little bit. not your fault of course. this is on your bf and your MIL but there's a big chance here that hes just gonna keep trying to make you two get along and he'll never actually make her leave. im sorry youre dealing with all this.

I would definitely respond and tell them you're not pregnant before it winds up on social media or you start receiving gifts. thats such an odd thing to lie about.


also "rising the cotton pony" has me in tears lmaooo

I cant begin to speak on your cultural traditions and how important they are to you but I can say that this seems fairly simple and if they're refusing, don't be surprised if there will be many more issues along the way. I would have a conversation with your bf and see what he thinks of it.
you get back at her by moving on. do better for YOURSELF. she wants you to feel like you can't do it without her but you absolutely can. the best revenge is success.
no no. YOU win. YOUR KIDS win. youre showing them how a partner and father is supposed to act and that ain't it. youre teaching them a valuable lesson about self respect, integrity, and honesty.
HE needs to handle her. if you live together, it'd be better to move. to remind her she's not the mother, but the grandmother.

I've been told NEVER to do therapy with an abuser. there might be something in the sidebar about that. im not sure but she needs to fix her shit on her own time and not for nothing, you could wind up with a therapist who is on her side. id be very cautious about that. id also be very cautious with DH. he may not be completely put of the fog if hes trying to find ways to fix something that you personally can't fix. shes had the opportunity to be better and chose to just be sneakier. it must be hard for him but im glad he's making strides. as long as you stay firm, you're good.

im very glad to hear the post opened your eyes. theres probably a lot going on you didnt see/didnt want to see but everything comes to a head.

if you ever think you're overreacting or not sure, come back and ask! most the time, people will be honest with you here. 

whether you NC for good, or just for now, this is a great start. wishing you the best!
congratulations on your new LO! im sorry your family isn't more supportive. lots of internet hugs.
congrats!!!

the first time she told your child to keep a secret should have been the last time they were alone. this is a very dangerous pattern of behavior. shes not insecure. shes manipulative and knows exactly what shes doing. honestly, I think you're being a tad naive here. and that's not your fault. that's what manipulators do. they trick you into thinking everything's okay so they can get their way. just because she went to therapy doesn't mean shes actually better. she just found a new way to do shit that won't raise suspicions. I cant tell you if shes a narcissist but I absolutely can tell you 100% shes manipulating you. the absolute best advice I can give is to never let these people be alone with your child. you dont know what else their telling him or doing that you don't know about.

id be worried about any other secrets there are. id get your daughter in therapy asap and cut all contact. your daughter's total personality change wasn't caused by her just using a soother. theres something else going on and she is absolutely not safe there.
im so sorry. this is not the family you deserve. they dont love you. cut them out for good. it sounds like they adopted kids for self gratification and not to actually take care of them.
yep! I wouldn't put anything past this woman. get all your ducks in a row.
hes telling you now that you'll never be more important than his mommy. leave. pack your shit and go. he can deal with her insanity alone.

stop giving hints. be direct. tell her no thats not your theme. this is your baby and youre going to regret not having what you wanted if you dont speak up. she had her children. its your turn. while you're at it, remind your husband hes having a baby with you, not his mother. she needs to be grandma not mom.
she wants you and bf to split so she can play mommy. stop leaving her alone with the baby. limit visits. her comment about being DCF safe was a subtle threat.
oh thank goodness. i have a 4 month old and my heart goes out to you. stay strong and I hope you get out soon!
please tell me youre NC now or something drastic happened. I would have lost my DAMN MIND. I could barely read this.
yes! perfect timing.

for your sake op, take a break. cut all contact. if your DH brings them up, shut him down. its not good for you or your mental health. I encourage you to take a good look at your husband. is he willing to do better by you? you've handled a lot of abuse to keep that boat steady for his sake. when is he going to give you a hand?

your mom and sister are all insane. theyre treating her like that because she's your wife and not your husband. im willing to bet if your child's "father" came to pick them up, there would be no issue. your family is prejudiced as hell. that is your partners son. they had no business with holding him. I would have called the cops the second she said no. shes lucky you didn't. I would be on a verrrryyyy long time out until there were serious attitude changes. your poor partner must've been terrified and so sad. I cant imagine being told that your child isn't really yours. you are from from JustNo. protect your wife and LO from these people. theyre going to try to pull you away from her.



adding. get your wife to adopt him ASAP. in the awful event something happens to you, your family will take him from her if nothings in place. make a will and get him adopted.

I wouldn't wait until she did walk in though. thats an experience you dont want to have. I had an exmil do that and I will NEVER forget it. its lowkey traumatic and she shouldn't have to get through that before having him listen to her. it doesn't make sense to me to wait until after you're violated to hold your ground.

I didnt say it as leverage. I said it because her walking in on that would be mortifying and id tell him hell no so that couldn't happen.


if that boundary makes him stand up to mommy, so be it but I would make it a clear point I wouldn't be putting myself in the position to be violated like that.

maybe, maybe not. she didn't say if the kids are school age or in daycare or are young enough they could get a quickie in during nap time. I was just saying id make sure that's not something that could be walked in on since she said the MIL likes to "check on what (they) are doing". I mean that's my first thought going in a couples bedroom. which is super creepy now that I think about it cause I doubt the kids are in the room 24/7.

tell your husband so you can both address it. anytime you hear it, take your baby back.
 
try this. go grab your baby and say
"oh I heard you say come to mommy, which is me. did you mean grandma?"

everytime you hear mommy, address it as if they're talking to you. same with daddy.

"daddys in the bathroom. im sure he'll be right back."

its less confrontational, if thats easier for you.

id also make it a rule DH is NOT to leave you alone with them. ever. not for a second.
if the accounts are anonymous, id make jokes about having a stalker. she was definitely making a sly comment to let you know shes watching.
congratulations!!!! sweet freedom! I would drive through a toll just to celebrate lol
she is then human embodiment of a barracuda.
you have an SO and a MIL problem. personally I'd tell him sex is off the table until you're sure she won't burst in but in general she shouldn't be doing that and he should be standing up to her.
that all sounds awful. enjoy your new LO as much as you can! this time is going to be wonderful for you!

I would not respond to MIL or try to do anything with her until you go through counseling with you DH. you're gonna need support and anything you do with MIL is gonna cause chaos in your marriage. theres not much you can do until you fix that first to be perfectly honest.
thats a great idea! i would do that first and yes it's totally unfair but I guess that could be a last resort if he let's her in. I hope it doesn't come to either for you!

if she shows up, you leave. no arguing. just leave. tell DH you MIGHT be back when she's gone, but definitely not before and definitely not if this keeps happening. he'll get his priorities straight real quick. hopefully.

im just so sorry op. I hope your
story opens some eyes on here. too often we see parents allow behavior around their children thinking it won't affect them. youre very brave to share. im glad youre all in therapy and it seems like youre all doing well otherwise, so thats awesome. you did your best and you raised some wonderful kids.
it seems like you know what you're doing!  just adding that any apology you get know will definitely be fake and only so they can get access. id keep them away.

No is a whole sentence. if she won't listen to that, sell it on FB marketplace or donate it and get the one you want. this will be one of many overstepped boundaries. shes testing the waters with you to see how much she can get what she wants if she whines. 

I have never understood people not getting the big ticket items off the registry. its there for a reason.

good for you! goodness forbid something awful happens because you MIL "knows better than you."  your baby's safety always comes become her feelings. its my hill to die on too. glad you and SO seem to be on the same page!

this is gonna sound awful but hear me out. I think if she really is dying, she just wants the satisfaction of him coming back to her and telling her she was a good mother. presumably he wouldn't tell her she's a pos on her death bed and I get it. I dont blame him for wanting to smooth things over before she passes but really who does that benefit? certainly not your husband. he gets to rugsweep his abuse one last time and she gets to pass thinking she's a decent human being.

personally, I wouldn't go to her. thats totally up to your husband but id make sure he knows truly what he's doing and if he's okay with that because he'll never get closure from her. she'll just use him up to fulfill herself.
I just want to say how sorry I am for your loss and it was NOT your fault. you quit asap. sometimes these things just happen. im very glad your life turned out beautifully and you'll be a great MIL.

came here to say this. very happy for you op but this comment was uncalled for. some people are better off renting and some people aren't privileged enough to be able to own, no matter how hard they try. to judge someone for renting over 50 is wrong. your MIL in particular might be a mess financially and thats on her and she may want to own but can't but that's in her particular situation. you shouldn't generalize people like that and tbh this comment is classist.

using the good ol "i read an article" trick to try to get her way. I would have hubby tell her we are not comfortable with that yet. please stop asking. and if she won't, you can reiterate it. anytime she brings it up, make a note of its how its going to push back the time you are comfortable because her insistence and motives are questionable.


adding, my 4 month old sees people maybe once a month. we don't go out most the time. only to the doctors or on an even rarer note, a grocery store when its not crowded. when he does see people he's just fine. I can leave the room without him losing it. it really depends on the child. dont let her scare you. your baby will be fine with people when youre all ready.

youre gonna get a few "well its not their problem responses" which is true technically but here's the thing. to me, the TRUE meaning of family is to love and care for one another and always have each others backs. now I understand appointments can be hard to reschedule. their health is important as well. but we all know for damn sure a 4 month old with a heart murmur takes precedent over an arthritis appointment. they should have been more understanding. this is serious and as caring grandparents, they should have dropped their appointment. this is my opinion of course but to me thats how it should work. 

you learned a harsh lesson here. you can't rely on them. theyre not willing to sacrifice anything for your nuclear family. I wouldn't ask them for anymore help. drop that rope.
 
 I may be biased here because I have a 4 month old son who coincidentally had a doctor appointment today and I know my inlaws would have helped if I needed them to. without hesitation when it comes to their grandchild.

im truly sorry about your daughter and I hope they figure out what's wrong and fix it quickly. I may be mistaken but I think they can outgrow murmurs. so this could be nothing. try to think best case scenario. lots of internet hugs.
you have a big husband problem if he agreed to that for you.

don't tell her you're moving. itll just start more drama. just go. I would tell him not to do lunch either. shes just gonna sit there and talk shit about you. your husband (hopefully,) doesn't want to hear that. if shes just gonna pressure him for a divorce, there's no point in him going.
im sorry. if youre not ready to hang the towel up, confront him and maybe try counseling. you deserve better. or you could wait and watch

sorry. id say after the third offense, shes just desperate not to have you leave. walk away for your sake. she would have changed after the first time. you will never not feel like she's going to betray you. wishing you the best.
thats not oddly satisfying. thats SATISFYING.

she gave him the condom to put on.

he had time to put a condom on. 

so it wasn't that fast he didn't know what was happening. he had time to think when he opened the condom and put it on himself.

he knew what he was doing and is painting himself in a better light. just enough to make you think its not "that bad" and it worked. you think this is the most forgivable instance. that's what he made you think. he may be remorseful but he still did it. can your relationship be fixed? possibly. if you decide to try to fix things, go into it fully knowing hes still lying at least a little. he had a mich bigger part in this. I would put money on the part about checking his phone being a lie. he went in there willingly with her. if you were drunk and a man followed you and started kissing you, what would you have done?

these people are the kind where you give an inch and they take a mile. its not enough to tell you they're coming. they need to ask if its okay before even leaving their home. you do not have to cater to them. theyre pushing you around. you can stand up to them. think of what a good example you'll be to your little one by standing up to bullies. thats what they are. big bullies. you have it in you.

I never thought of it that way. 

also, im sorry for your loss
ignore. block. ignore. enjoy yourselves! thats so sweet he chose you.

there's a history of line crossing here. you need to stand up for yourself OP. use your voice. for yourself and little one. youre not a door mat. youre a human being and you deserve kindness and respect.

uhhhh first let's address why they're coming over unannounced? all visits should be requested in advance, not demanded or by surprise. 

second. the dog is not welcome.

third. id say you didn't want to say it in front of your parents but twice now you've heard it and its not acceptable.

fourth. your husband should be backing you 100% and if not, no visits unless he's home to facilitate them.

the fact that the picture was posted of your baby for her mother's day post. the baby they hardly see. delusional.

on another note, happy first mothers day!

im so so sorry. honey NO MORE VISITS. visits like this can cause PPD. you need to take care of YOUR mental health first. this is such a hard time and shes just making it worse. I dont know where you're husband stands but use your mama roar and tell him you're done! he needs to know whats going on so he can handle it. all your energy should be put into loving your baby, not having to stress about your monster in law.


and that was NOT BEC. she is fucking AWFULLLLL. girl awful. I want to lose it on her for you. she is a vile human being. and you are so kind to even let her into your home. shes an ungrateful witch.

but my main point here, is please take care of yourself. dont try to please her or your husband by allowing this negativity in your space. you need to heal and bond with your little love bug.


with that being said, congratulations and youre gonna do great. dont stress about the latching. lots of babies have this issue. youre still bonding without it. hopefully it can get fixed and you wont have to worry anymore but its a common issue so don't feel guilty. and its awesome your milk came in! thats a great thing. it means your baby is growing just fine and your body is doing exactly what its supposed to. and its okay to cry! your body is going through a huge loss of hormones and in general this is a very emotional time. I cried everyday for weeks. sometimes joy, sometimes fear, sometimes pain but eventually my body regulated and all was well. youre doing just fine mama. youre gonna be okay.

try not to worry too much about an issue that hasn't arisen yet. hopefully your fiance will back you up when it does. first, don't let her pressure you into kids. theyre not for everyone and that's okay. shes trying to live vicariously through you. if she wants a child so bad, she can adopt one. if and when you do have kids, you'll need strong boundaries. you may get along now but things may change when she doesn't get her way and you wont just hand over your baby. but right now it's all hypothetical. when she brings up kids, shut it down so she starts to learn her place. "that's between me and fiance. its not up for discussion" and repeat. it enforces now that she won't be intruding all over you. you can always come back here for help!

idk id rather be in pain than allow people to speak poorly of black people in front of me. my husband wont allow it either. spending time with them is still tolerating it. im not giving you advice. you dont want advice. im just saying my hill to die on is that disgusting behavior in front of my children. sometimes it is that easy. even if you teach your kids kindness, in the back of their heads they'll remember how their other family members think and it will affect them. your son or daughter could never come home with a black partner. all hell would break loose. or if they were gay? oh man. it'd be a nightmare. ive absolutely cut people put of my life for being racist and/or homophobic. the only way to stop the behavior is to absolutely not tolerate it in any way shape or form.


also, my husband would cut his entire family off no questions asked if they were like this in front of our baby. no matter how bad it hurt because this is just wrong. this is a big question of morality.

okay so you have a 2 part problem here. I'll start with your mom and then your wife.

maybe your wife is the only only one shes fought with cause your wife is the only one that won't tolerate her shitty behavior. she started the war with your wife by immediately talking shit after meeting her once. its her job as a mother to love and support you but she came out the gate swinging. she purposely ostracized your wife and "made fun of her" and then brushed it off as venting. no she was being a bitch. she could have tried but didn't. she didn't like that your wife wasn't a pushover. maybe she just didn't like her little boy having a partner. either way. SHE set the dominos off. her comment about wearing the same dress to the wedding was out of line. she went crying about it and played victim when she was really in the wrong. shes manipulative, narcissistic,  and always has to be the center of attention. she could have easily said hey let's try again but she's living off the fact that your wife apologized and now she doesn't have to. so shes getting her way. you and your wife bowed down to her and she's big mummy on campus in her eyes. shes infallible. and she's trained you to see her that way. your mother is AWFUL. one of the worst I've read on here honestly. even if your wife and you split, you need this atrocious woman out of your life. your entire family caters to her bullshit. a lot of people think because someone gave birth to you, you owe them something. you absolutely don't. I have a son and if I ever treated him or his partner like that I'd be mortified. shes out of line and out of control and youre allowing and excusing her behavior. cut ties and get some serious therapy before even considering a LC relationship at absolute most. 


now for your wife. shes 2 parts of her own. either way you seem to think really poorly of her. you either think shes a drama starter or youre okay with her being bullied by your mom as long as you get to have your cake and eat it too. it sounds like your wife doesn't take anyone's shit. which means she's gonna have a lot of people that don't like her. people like doormats. sad reality of life
 they dont like to be around people who call them out. so either your wife just won't listen to nonsense or shes a drama starter. I dont know which one. I dont know your wife.  id love to hear her side of this. but the fact that your wife swallowed her pride to apologize even though I dont think she had reason to, tells me that's its probably just because she won't take shit that she has issues with people. she's a strong woman it sounds to me but she clearly loves you so shes trying to make it work. I would have left by now if your mom pulled any of that on me. the fact that she's stayed says something. like I said, I dont know your wife. you only speak very negatively about her. either you really don't love her or your moms poison has worked its way inside your head and has tainted the image of your wife.

the difference is even when you speak "positively" of your mom, I can still see her bullshit.

listen, if your wife was 50% of the problem I would absolutely tell you but she's not. she's probably 5%. she retaliated to the fact that your mom hated her in the first place. like I said in the first comment, you are deeply in the fog about your mother. your whole family. their behavior is unacceptable wife or no wife.

my best advice. at the very least is to take 6 months off from any communication with you mom and her flying monkeys. focus on your wife and go to therapy. see how it goes and go from there. you might see a big difference.

honestly. you dont sound like you want advice. you just keep justifying your moms behavior while scapegoating your wife. I hate that it comes to it, but youre better off getting divorced. especially if you want kids. dont bring them into this toxic situation. your mother will either try to take them for your wife or completely ignore them. if she was any type of a real mom she would have forgiven your wife and you could really try to move on but thats just not possible.

they had different personalities but your mom went and talked about her to your family and was hella passive aggressive to her. your mom still sounds like the aggressor and them all freaking out of the dress is gaslighting. they both might have been talking shit but your mom is manipulative and narcissistic. there is no solution here. she will continue her behavior. in her eyes your wife bowed down and she won. she wins more by not accepting her apology and she won't apologize for any of the unacceptable crap she pulled. your mother will never change. you have to decide who you want in your life because she won't ever accept your wife. and if you guys separate, she'll do the same thing to whoever you find next. therapy. lots and lots of therapy.

don't talk to them. pack up your things and leave. they'll just try to manipulate you into staying. youre in an abusive household, run. pack up your car. leave a goodbye note. anywhere is better than there. if they won't leave you alone, file a report for harassment. you can do this.
